name: Hydra Will

abilities.name: Marsh Fang
abilities.effect: A weak single venom spit that poisons one close target.

abilities.name: Scab-Over
abilities.effect: A small slow heal that closes cuts: borrowed regeneration.

acquire.equipPiece: One green snake-scale gauntlet on the right forearm (the only equipped piece); green venom streaks and a thin afterimage on quick strikes.

abilities.name: Nine-Head Strike
abilities.effect: Several heads lash out at up to three foes at once; the afterimages show nine necks.

abilities.name: Heads Regrow
abilities.effect: A big regrowth heal over several seconds; the glowing neck-stump grows a new head.

integrate.transformation: Whole body becomes a marsh hydra-humanoid in scale armour: a fanged reptile head with slit yellow eyes, five extra snake-necked heads rising from the shoulders and back, one stump that visibly regrows, webbed claws, digitigrade legs and a thick spiked tail.

equip.weapon: A segmented fang-sword whose hilt is a snake head, grown from a tooth of the main head.
equip.armor: Overlapping marsh-green scale mail with a collar of five snake-necked pauldron heads.
equip.hair_eyes: Hair splitting into thin green snake-locks; slit yellow eyes.

lore: The Lernaean Hydra of the marsh: poison breath, many necks, heads that grow back when cut. Its will mends flesh but keeps the holder in pain.
pitch: The Lernaean Hydra is a marsh monster of poison and many necks whose heads regrow when cut. Acquire keeps you human with one green snake-scale gauntlet, lending a weak venom spit and a slow heal. Integrate makes you a marsh-green beastman in scale armour with a fanged head, five snake-necked pauldron heads and a thick spiked tail, a fast multi-strike healer paid for with constant venom fever and strain.
untrained: An untrained holder feels heads straining out of their neck: burning poison in the blood, fever and spasms when the will wakes, and a wound that closes badly and aches. The will lay dormant until forcibly awakened; if the holder cannot balance it the clash tears at body and core and can kill, and only training the holder's own core and the beast core (best teacher: the beast itself) tames it.

spirit.echo: A marsh-green many-necked beastman: a main reptile head and five extra snake-necked heads fanned from the shoulders and back, one stump regrowing, webbed claws, a thick spiked tail.
spirit.look: A lime-green orb with several thin dark necks coiled round it, each ending in a tiny glinting fang, one neck stump slowly regrowing.
